text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
The rumors about Narita Brian being in a 
slump seem to be true. Her running style 
is completely different from before.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...I hope they come back, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah—!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...You're getting back into it, Brian. Bit 
by bit, it's starting to come back to you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still, it feels like something is missing. 
What on earth could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Trainy! Give me another round of uphill 
dashes!"

Today's menu is already over. She should 
be completely exhausted, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I've got a pretty good idea of what I need 
to do now.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, I need to get to as high a 
place as possible."

I don't know the full details, but... 
Either way, it seems necessary if I'm to 
challenge Narita Brian.

Though the world around them changes, 
Hishi Amazon and Narita Brian remain 
entirely unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

Hishi Amazon sprinted vigorously up the 
slope. From that day on, the days of doing 
additional training continued.

And then came the Tenno Sho (Autumn). 
Though reports claimed Narita Brian was in 
poor shape, the crowd's expectations 
remained sky-high.
However—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“The ‘Monster’ Narita Brian puts on a 
performance unbecoming of her usual 
self...!”

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: No way, did she always run like that...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

The sight of a genius who had lost her 
former prowess sent massive shockwaves 
through the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Has it not fully healed yet? Will I... 
really be able to make a comeback like 
this?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if we'll ever get to see that 
Narita Brian from back then again...
A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Today, having achieved victory in numerous 
GⅠ races, her powerful running has become 
the talk of the town—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
We'll now be conducting a pre-race 
interview with Hishi Amazon-san for the 
Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, good to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
In last year's Arima Kinen, you called 
Narita Brian your rival, but—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Is there anyone in the Japan Cup you would 
consider a rival?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
My rival hasn't changed. The wall I have 
to overcome is Narita Brian!

Everyone knew Narita Brian was in a slump. 
Curiously, they all listened intently to 
what Hishi Amazon had to say.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I know about the slump. I know people are 
disappointed, and I understand the anxiety 
her fans are feeling, too."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's true Brian isn't running monstrous 
races like before! But—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
She's not done yet. You guys know that 
deep down too, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Narita Brian" isn't strong just because 
she's talented.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
She's strong because she can't help but 
run.

Hishi Amazon's straightforward words 
echoed through the quiet press conference 
room.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to feel anxious at all. 
You'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
She is "Narita Brian." She'll claw her way 
back up for sure.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ... My rival hasn't changed one bit.

Hishi Amazon's attitude quickly spread 
throughout the world—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
...Did you see Hishi Amazon's interview? 
She said Narita Brian is her rival.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I saw it. I dunno... Seeing that 
kinda struck a chord with me, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
"Now that you mention it, Narita Brian's 
expression while running hadn't changed 
from before at all."

Words like that began to be heard here and 
there.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, let's do this, Trainy!

As strong and gallant as ever, Hishi 
Amazon's back fades into the distance as 
she dashes up the hill course.
Only a little longer until the Japan Cup.
